name: Post-Dip Mean Reversion (Low Gas)
description: Ethereum gas dropped under 20 gwei following minor retracement. Historically, low-gas periods after minor selloffs yield positive 24-48h rebounds.
profitability_assessment: High probability accumulation zone. Low gas minimizes execution overhead while mean reversion supports positive expected value.

name: Weekend Consolidation (Ultra-Low Gas)
description: Weekend liquidity drain with ultra-low base fee (<= 15 gwei) and flat volatility. Low slippage, optimal accumulation window.
profitability_assessment: Stable range accumulation. Low transaction fees ensure minimal drag on capital.

name: Overextended Bull Run (High Volatility)
description: Rapid multi-day price surge with elevated RSI. Historically high probability of sharp mean reversion pullbacks and high slippage.
profitability_assessment: Unfavorable risk-reward. Buying into overextended tops historically incurs immediate drawdowns.

name: Gas Spike Congestion Panic
description: Severe network congestion resulting in gas spikes (> 35 gwei) and erratic liquidations. High slippage and negative expected value.
profitability_assessment: Hazardous execution environment. Gas overhead consumes potential gains and slippage risks are extreme.

name: Liquidation Cascade Capitulation
description: Heavy market sell-off with high volume. Knife-catching risk unless strict balance floors and dip stabilization are verified.
profitability_assessment: Moderate risk. Highly contingent on strict Z3 balance floor invariants to prevent excessive drawdown.
